issue: Historical Worker mode/handoff quotes could overwrite newer owned saved/draft choices during an unrelated edit; the rejected choice could also survive in biography or an assistant question prefix.
fix: An older quote may recover missing metadata or preserve identical owned choices. A conflicting older quote is discarded; a current quoted change remains eligible for normal admission.
The effective draft mode set replaces the whole saved set. Its owned category, modes and handoff are revalidated against the current full catalog and carried into the next completed revision.
An obsolete historical declaration is distinct from a malformed or duplicate current declaration, which remains unresolved.
Untrusted full biography and assistant acknowledgement are withheld when a mode declaration is rejected/discarded; independently admitted name, service and calendar fields remain.
Explicit profile Save remains required. No additional provider call or automatic retry is introduced.

expectedFailures: saved REMOTE overwritten by stale BOTH
draft REMOTE overwritten by stale BOTH
newer handoff area overwritten by stale area
stale mode retained in biography/question prefix

tests.twoTurnCoverage: Both saved and draft regressions call the actual Worker handler twice; the second call uses the first completed taxonomy plan as revision-2 draft bindings alongside unchanged saved bindings. REMOTE remains REMOTE after a later name-only edit.
positiveBoundaries: Current explicit mode and handoff correction remains allowed
Historical quote for the same owned choices keeps current biography

Archived category ID is never preserved
